excerpt: The DarkSide-50 detector, a dual-phase argon Time Projection Chamber (TPC), was hosted in Hall C of the Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso and operated from 2013 to 2020. GADMC is currently building inside the LNGS Hall-C DarkSide-20k, a two-phase LAr detector with a 50 tonnes active mass; the experiment is currently under construction, with operations expected to begin in 2027.
